summary.text: Herald of Agamemnon and ready squire, sent with Eurybates to lead Briseis from Achilles' hut — and later bearer of the lambs when the kings swore their truce before Troy.

story.text: When Agamemnon would not end his quarrel with Achilles, he called Talthybius and Eurybates and ordered them to the hut of Peleus' son: take fair-cheeked Briseis by the hand and lead her to the king's quarters, and if Achilles refused, Agamemnon would come himself with a larger company. Unwilling they went along the shore of the barren sea.

In the truce before the duel of Menelaus and Paris, Agamemnon sent Talthybius to the hollow ships for a lamb, and Iris went to Helen in the likeness of her husband's sister, wife of Antenor — the herald's errand paired with the goddess' message as the armies paused.
